Players Committee card image of [[Where Are Those Droidekas?! (V)]] (original printing), game text: “Deploy on table. Non-unique destroyer droids are deploy -1 and forfeit +1. While all your characters at sites are destroyer droids and Neimoidians, opponent's characters are defense value -1 (to a minimum of 3) for each destroyer droid present. (Immune to Alter.)”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/wherearethosedroidekas.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018).
